prompt: An AI answer says: "The library opens at 7 a.m. on Sundays (Library Policy, section 6)." Describe, step by step, how you would check this claim.

criteria.label: Finds the source independently
criteria.look_for: locating the cited policy yourself, not through the chatbot

criteria.label: Checks existence and wording
criteria.look_for: checking that section 6 exists and says the same thing

criteria.label: Decides what to do
criteria.look_for: keep, fix or drop the claim, citing the real source

reference: First I would find the library's policy on the library website myself. Then I would check whether it has a section 6 at all and read what it says about Sunday hours. If the section is missing or says something else, I treat the claim as unsupported and use the hours from the real source, citing that page, not the chatbot.
